title.en: Inflow, outflow and the set point

description.zh: 流出量跟存量成正比时，存量会自己停在“进水 ÷ 漏的比例”处，被推开后差距按固定时间减半。
description.en: When outflow is proportional to the stock, the stock settles at inflow ÷ leak rate and any push decays by half in a fixed time.

zh: 为什么身体能保持平衡
en: why does the body stay balanced

description.en: The enzyme that breaks down alcohol saturates early, so a roughly fixed amount leaves per hour: a straight-line fall and no plateau if you drink faster.

zh: 为什么酒精是直线下降
en: how fast alcohol leaves the body

description.zh: 胰岛素和胰高血糖素把血糖往回推；反应太弱会偏高很久，太晚又太猛会跌过头。
description.en: Insulin and glucagon push glucose back; a weak response leaves it high, a late and strong one overshoots into a dip.

zh: 糖尿病血糖为什么降不下来

title.en: Fever as a raised set point

description.zh: 致热原把体温设定点拨高，所以发烧时发冷、退烧时出汗；中暑的高热则是散热到了上限。
description.en: Pyrogens raise the temperature set point, so a fever starts with chills and breaks with sweating; heat stroke is cooling at its limit instead.

en: why do you feel cold with a fever

description.zh: 有效浓度和有害浓度之间的距离；同样的总量分几次吃、清除变慢，会让体内的量落在窗里还是窗外。
description.en: The gap between an effective and a harmful level; how splitting the same daily dose, or slower clearance, keeps the level inside or outside it.

zh: 为什么肾功能差要减量
en: why reduce dose for kidney impairment

description.en: During exercise the body holds oxygen delivery and moves heart rate and stroke volume; training lowers resting heart rate, age lowers the maximum.

why heart rate rises in exercise

description.en: Concentrations between the sensitive and resistant MICs clear the way for resistant bacteria; whether stopping early favours resistance depends on the dose.

en: do you need to finish antibiotics

description.en: Once the immune share exceeds 1 − 1/R₀, each case infects fewer than one other on average and the outbreak dies out.

en: how many people need to be vaccinated

label.zh: 差距每 ln2/k 减半就是半衰期
label.en: The gap halves every ln2/k: the half-life

reason.zh: 第 1 章漏水桶的差距每 ln2/k 减半；第 2 章不需要新概念，这个时间就是药物的半衰期，反复给药在约 5 个半衰期后到达平台（97%）。
reason.en: In chapter 1 the leaky bucket’s gap halves every ln2/k; chapter 2 needs no new idea, because that time is the drug’s half-life, and repeated doses reach a plateau after about five half-lives (97%).

label.en: A bucket whose exit has a cap

reason.zh: 第 3 章把酒精写成第 1 章的桶，只是出口被酶饱和封顶：每小时只出固定的量，进得比它快就没有平台。
reason.en: Chapter 3 writes alcohol as chapter 1’s bucket with an exit capped by a saturated enzyme: a fixed amount leaves per hour, so intake faster than that has no plateau.

label.zh: 高热：出口饱和，和酒精同构
label.en: Heat stroke: a saturated exit, like alcohol

reason.zh: 第 5 章用第 3 章的“封顶出口”区分两种体温升高：发烧是设定点被调高，高热是出汗已到上限、外界热负荷超过它。
reason.en: Chapter 5 uses chapter 3’s capped exit to separate two kinds of high temperature: fever moves the set point, while heat stroke is sweating at its limit with the heat load above it.

label.zh: 负反馈守住被移动的设定点
label.en: Feedback defends a moved set point

reason.zh: 第 5 章沿用第 4 章的负反馈：体温被推开后会被拉回设定点；发烧时设定点本身上移，所以人在 38 度时还觉得冷。
reason.en: Chapter 5 reuses chapter 4’s negative feedback: a pushed temperature is pulled back to its set point; in a fever the set point itself moves up, so at 38 degrees one still feels cold.

label.zh: 第 2 章的给药模型加上下限
label.en: Chapter 2’s dosing model, with two limits

reason.zh: 第 6 章的浓度曲线就是第 2 章的给药模型；同样总剂量分成每天 3 次时峰谷都在窗内，清除变慢一倍时第 24 小时起越过上限。
reason.en: Chapter 6’s concentration curve is chapter 2’s dosing model; the same daily total split three ways stays inside the window, and with clearance halved it crosses the upper limit from hour 24.

label.zh: 守住一个量，另一个量要摆动
label.en: To hold one quantity, another swings

reason.zh: 第 7 章沿用第 4 章的反馈结构：心率随需求滞后调整，以守住供氧；守住的是氧，摆动的是心率。
reason.en: Chapter 7 reuses chapter 4’s feedback structure: heart rate follows demand with a lag to hold oxygen delivery; oxygen is held, heart rate swings.

label.zh: 浓度来自第 2 章的给药模型

reason.zh: 第 8 章的抗生素浓度用第 2 章的模型算（每 8 小时一次、半衰期 4 小时）；浓度落在两种菌的最低抑菌浓度之间的时间，决定耐药菌能否胜出。
reason.en: Chapter 8 computes the antibiotic level with chapter 2’s model (every 8 h, half-life 4 h); the time the level spends between the two strains’ MICs decides whether resistant cells win.

label.en: In and out balance at population scale

reason.zh: 第 9 章把第 1 章的进出平衡放到人群上：每个病例传出的新病例少于 1（Re < 1）时疫情自己消退；阈值是 1 − 1/R₀。
reason.en: Chapter 9 moves chapter 1’s in/out balance to a population: when each case passes on fewer than one new case (Re < 1) an outbreak dies out; the threshold is 1 − 1/R₀.

label.zh: 酶饱和：每小时只代谢固定的量
label.en: A saturated enzyme clears a fixed amount per hour

reason.zh: 第 3 章引用酶那一页的第 1 步：酒精脱氢酶在低浓度下就已饱和（Km 约 5 mg/100 mL），代谢速度近似恒定，这就是零级动力学。
reason.en: Chapter 3 cites step 1 of the Enzymes page: alcohol dehydrogenase saturates at low levels (Km about 5 mg/100 mL), so the clearance rate is nearly constant, which is zero-order kinetics.

reason.zh: 第 4 章引用反馈控制的第 1 步：胰岛素反馈太弱时血糖久居高位，又强又晚时先冲高再跌到偏低，和控制器的增益与延迟是同一组取舍。
reason.en: Chapter 4 cites step 1 of Feedback Control: weak insulin feedback leaves glucose high, strong and late feedback overshoots into a low, the same trade-off as a controller’s gain and delay.

label.zh: 心输出量 = 心率 × 每搏量
label.en: Cardiac output = heart rate × stroke volume

reason.zh: 第 7 章以血液循环的第 3、4 步为基础：心输出量等于心率乘每搏量，运动时需求上升，每搏量先到顶，余下全靠心率。
reason.en: Chapter 7 builds on steps 3 and 4 of Blood Circulation: cardiac output is heart rate times stroke volume; in exercise stroke volume tops out first and the rest falls on heart rate.

reason.zh: 第 8 章说抗生素浓度在“挑选”细菌：中等浓度杀死敏感菌、留下耐药菌，正是自然选择在一次疗程里的样子。
reason.en: Chapter 8 says the antibiotic level selects bacteria: a middling level kills sensitive cells and leaves resistant ones, natural selection within one course of treatment.

reason.zh: 第 9 章把 R₀ 交给公共卫生那一页的第 0 步，只推出阈值 1 − 1/R₀：R₀ = 3 时 67%，麻疹 12–18 时 92–94%。
reason.en: Chapter 9 leaves R₀ to step 0 of the Public Health page and derives only the threshold 1 − 1/R₀: 67% at R₀ = 3, 92–94% for measles at 12–18.
